reason: vllm 0.31.0 is pinned by this torch 2.13 line (vllm 0.27.0-0.31.0 require torch==2.13.0); fix requires vllm>=0.32.0, a framework bump. vllm is present only as the trl online-RL rollout backend; the vulnerable path needs OffloadingConnector with TieringOffloadingSpec and a P2P secondary tier, which training jobs do not configure.

vllm 0.31.0; fix requires vllm>=0.32.0, but no trl release supports it yet: vllm 0.32.0 changed the /inference/v1/generate logprob wire format, which trl handles only from huggingface/trl#7799 (unreleased; trl 1.16.0 caps vllm at 0.31.0), so bumping breaks trl's vllm server-mode rollouts. The vulnerable ImageMediaIO path decodes image bytes sent in requests to a vllm server; vllm here is trl's rollout backend, fed only the trainer's own prompts. Bump vllm with the first trl release supporting 0.32.
